NeuroPulse Implantable Stimulator System Design History File · NEURO

REQ-0002 Single-fault amplitude ceiling

approved · verified by test, analysis

The system shall not deliver a stimulation amplitude exceeding 8 mA under any single-fault condition, including loss of the sense-electrode feedback signal used by the closed-loop control algorithm (DES-0001).

Implements

  • USR-0002: No unexpected increases in stimulation intensity

Refined by
